discovery_only.title: ଢିଙ୍କି
discovery_only.author: Deba Tripathy
discovery_only.use: Topic lead only. No prose, translations, poems, photographs or distinctive narrative reused.

existing_coverage: essential-odia-dhaga.md and cultural-book.json repeat proverb explanations
novelty.finding: No dedicated tool article found in inspected inventory. New article explains mechanism, dated Odisha use, grain-processing distinctions and labour. This is not a claim of exhaustive semantic deduplication.
novelty.reuse_before_research: No matching mapped task; existing proverb narratives and prior corrections reused as coverage/context, not new tool evidence.

sources.title: District industries — Old Time Industries
sources.locator: History & Evaluation of Industries / Old Time Industries, first paragraph
supports: Dhinki identified as leg-operated paddy dehusking; Pohurani separately hand-operated.
limits: Undated historical account, not current prevalence.

sources.title: Material Culture of Chuktia Bhunjia Tribes of Odisha: An Anthropological Interpretation
sources.locator: Printed p45 methods; pp55–56 Husking Tools; Figure8(a)
supports: 2023 Sunabeda fieldwork; wooden fulcrum-supported pounder, iron-ringed tip and foot operation.
limits: Community and locality specific; no statewide prevalence or origin claim; photographs not licensed for reuse.

sources.title: Baseline Survey: Kalahandi District 2016–17, Phase1
sources.publisher: Nabakrushna Choudhury Centre for Development Studies / Odisha Millets Mission
supports: Millet-processing context; dhenki dehusking distinct from chakki grinding; processing labour largely borne by women.
limits: 73.6% is manual processing overall, not Dhinki use. No rice-only or current statewide inference.

sources.title: Rice: Post-harvest Operations
sources.author: Ray Lantin
sources.locator: Printed pp4–6 grain processing; p19 threshing; p48 gender and mechanisation
supports: Husk and bran differ; pounding can remove both; mechanisation has labour and income consequences.
limits: Older international review, not current Odisha data; no automatic unpolished-rice or health claim.

sources.title: Agrobiodiversity Conservation and Tribal Women of Koraput, Odisha
sources.locator: Data and Methods; Results paragraph preceding Fig19
supports: Local account of leg/hand pounding and women’s household food processing.
limits: No verified publication date;2018 footer not publication date; inconsistent daily-hour estimates omitted; images all-rights-reserved.

reviewers.Anvesha: Separate AI source research, read-only findings delivered; not a human or field review.
reviewers.Disha: Primary passages independently opened for all five sources; discovery page inspected. No source images reused.

omitted_claims: Dhinki use percentage inferred from manual-processing percentage

media.reuse_permissions: No permission claimed for source photographs.
